title: Final Answer A
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that A_x = 0.

title: Final Answer B
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive that p_perp = -e A.

title: Reasoning for A
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear justification for why A_x must be zero based on the properties of electromagnetic waves.

title: Use of Gauge Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the gauge condition that the scalar potential is zero.

title: Transverse Momentum Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain how the transverse momentum relates to the vector potential and the charge of the particle.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes when deriving the relationship between momentum and vector potential.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios where the results hold true.
